label: 3. Did you hear about the terrorist attack agains…

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Did you hear about the terrorist attack against the TV station several days ago?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: The TV station isn't too pleased.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: They've been covering it practically 24/7.
I haven't been watching the news.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Since the media hasn't sunk their claws into you,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: you may be able to give me an honest answer.
What do you wanna know?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Do you think the perpetrator

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: behind this attack

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: comes from the Outer Rim?
I hesitate to answer.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Cat got your tongue?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I'm just asking.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Don't be so nervous.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Think of it as a Rorschach test.
I guess so.
I don't think so.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You think so too?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I didn't expect that.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I thought you'd say

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: the opposite.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You really are familiar with the Outer Rim. How impressive!
Did I guess correctly?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Who knows?
Is he not from the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I figured that's what you'd say.
Did I guess correctly?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Who knows?
Is he not from the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: No idea.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I heard that he was born and grew up at Royal Road.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: At 18, he was sent to the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: where he spent the next 18 years of his life.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: It's the same amount of time he spent at Royal Road.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Which begs the question:

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: which was it that led him astray?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Royal Road, where he grew up,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: or the Outer Rim, where he spent his adulthood?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What do you think?
Royal Road.
Outer Rim.
Neither.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: How come?
It's where he grew up.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Even if he spent most of his adult life in the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: he was born at Royal Road.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Therefore, that's where it all went wrong?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I wish you could say that to these damned TV stations.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: They're always going on about how the Outer Rim corrupted him.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: It's like you said,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: your birthplace has the greatest effect on you.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Although his time in the Outer Rim, to be fair, may have

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: given birth to his criminal ways,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: at least that's what the news says.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: So you think it was the Outer Rim as well?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You're no different from those talking heads

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: on the news, spewing their vitriol.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: According to them,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: although he was born at Royal Road,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: his time at the Outer Rim turned him into what he is today.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: So you could say it was the Outer Rim that did him in.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Neither?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Of course, he was born at Royal Road

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: and might have been "reborn" as a terrorist

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: However,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: one can't place the blame on any one place.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: At least not on one any more than the other.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Actually, I'm not too bothered to get to the bottom of this.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I'm just curious about your thoughts on this matter.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Anyway, I got what I wanted out of this.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: It was interesting chatting with you.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We'll talk later.
